caseNameFull: Rosebud Sioux Tribe v. Kneip, Governor of South Dakota

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 425 U. S. 989.] Motion of the Solicitor General to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae granted and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondent allotted 15 additional minutes to present oral argument.
